title: search output
description: Printed with --json on exit 0. Newest first by id, no body. total is the number of matching notes after the status filter and before --limit; shown is the length of notes; hidden is the number of notes that match every other filter (repo, topic, kind, label; for search also the text) and are superseded or expired, 0 with --all, so total + hidden is total with --all.
